title: Code and derived data for: Forest thinning and wildfire do not increase surface-water diversions in California
description: Conditional permutation importance, streamflow analyses, and AutoML projections of hydropower and consumptive surface-water diversions across California's HUC8 watersheds, water years 2011 to 2024, with projections to 2070 under CMIP5 and CMIP6. Includes the HUC8 input tables and the projection inputs. Version 1.2.1 adds the README and the licence to version 1.2.0.
